candidate.rationale: (-1,-1) contains the complete central church roof massing, palace pilot roof, open square, ordinary blocks, courtyard/tree context, and the small retained portico; no missing source cells. The north front facade is back-facing; the camera and geometry are not changed.
candidate.sourcePixels: Unmodified crop; no CLAHE/saturation lift or painted-neighbour strips in this experiment
